title: Flat plate moments by the direct design method

rubric.text: The response should check the limits of the method (including L/D <= 2), use the clear span ln = 7.0 m in Mo = qu l2 ln^2/8, use the flat-plate end-span coefficients 0.26, 0.52 and 0.70 without edge beams and 0.65 / 0.35 in interior spans, and give 75% of the interior negative moment to the column strip; it should not cite ACI 318-19 clauses for the coefficients.

expert_notes: Limits met: >= 3 spans, equal spans, ratio 1, no offset, uniform load, L/D = 0.32. Mo = 13.3 x 7.5 x 7.0^2/8 = 611.0 kN.m. End span: 0.70Mo = 427.7 (interior negative), 0.26Mo = 158.9 (exterior negative), 0.52Mo = 317.7 positive. Interior span: 0.65Mo = 397.1; column strip 75% = 297.8 (3.75 m strip). Centre-to-centre span gives Mo = 701.4 (+14.8%), outside the tolerance.
